ui.title: Canonical Model Mapper
ui.tagline: Maps a new source system's table onto your canonical data model: profiles the data, proposes every field's mapping with a confidence and a reason, checks required-field coverage, and publishes only what a data steward approves.

actions.label: Run: Map a source to the canonical model
actions.description: Point Kaman at a new source system's table. It profiles the data, proposes a field-by-field mapping to your canonical model with confidence, checks coverage of required fields, and publishes the mapping only after a data steward approves it.

actions.label: Ask the Source Profiler
actions.description: Profiles a source table in the database.
